_readme: Every figure the site uses that is not in the generated data files (states, wages, shares, ahs, energy, solar: scripts/build-data.py) lives here, with its source. Re-read each value on its source before changing it and update retrieved_at.

solar._source: nlr_siu_2026, slide 44 (page 45): EnergySage, median gross cost per watt by state, second half of 2025
solar._medianKwSource: lbnl_tts_2024, page 14: "Median residential system sizes reached 7.4 kW in 2023"
